title: Extract onboarding intro-page Color(0x...) literals into core/theme constants
why: The same navy (0xFF1A36A5) is hand-typed as a private constant independently in all 3 files (19 raw Color literals total: 6+2+11), instead of one shared source. A future rebrand or dark-mode pass for the intro carousel requires finding and updating every hex literal by hand, with no compile-time link tying the copies together if one drifts out of sync. This is exactly the pattern the (currently non-functional) no_color_literal_outside_theme custom lint targets.
recommendation: Add the ~8 distinct hex values used across the 3 files to AppColors/AppTheme (or an onboarding-scoped palette class in core/theme/) and import it instead of redefining per file.
acceptance_criteria: Once custom_lint is fixed, dart run custom_lint reports zero no_color_literal_outside_theme violations under lib/features/onboarding/presentation/widgets/
